theorem factor_scale {R : Type} [CommRing R] (v w r a b c inverseD0 inverseD1 inverseD2 : R) (inverseScale : v*w=1) : factor (v^3*r) (v*a) (v*b) (v*c) (w^2*inverseD0) (w^2*inverseD1) (w^2*inverseD2) = v^3 * factor r a b c inverseD0 inverseD1 inverseD2

theorem factor_equals_symmetric_determinant {R : Type} [CommRing R] (h0 h1 h2 a b c inverseD0 inverseD1 inverseD2 : R) (inverse0 : (h1*h2)*inverseD0=1) (inverse1 : (h0*h2)*inverseD1=1) (inverse2 : (h0*h1)*inverseD2=1) : factor (-(h0*h1*h2)) a b c inverseD0 inverseD1 inverseD2 = h0*h1*h2-h0*a^2-h1*b^2-h2*c^2-2*a*b*c
